answers.question: cafe Järnvägscafeet: no opening hours
answers.answer: Still open. Jernhusen lists the café (Järnvägscafé, tel. 0554-415 55, links only to its Facebook page) without hours; the Facebook page can't be read (robots). Visit Värmland's page (regional tourism body, not on the allowed source list, so not used for hours) mentions only weekday breakfast 08–09:45 and lunch 11–14, not full opening hours. Leave without hours.

open: Järnvägscafé opening hours: no allowed source states them (only Facebook, unreadable).
Where the café is inside the building: no plan or owner text says.
How the island platforms (2 & 3, 4 & 5, 6 & 7) are reached (tunnel, level crossing, lifts): OSM maps no stairs, underpass or lift at Kil and no owner/Trafikverket/Värmlandstrafik text was found.
Entrance street: Jernhusen's address is Stationsplan 3; OSM tags no entrance node, so no entrance position.
No published plan of Kil station was found (Jernhusen links none; no Värmlandstrafik station map for Kil found).
Ticket machines, lockers: Jernhusen lists none for Kil; not confirmed either way.
